SOURCE: JAX/XLA CUDA compilation of a bfloat16 concatenate primitive
CODE_PATH: Dreamer RSSM bfloat16 block concatenation; independently reproduced by jnp.concatenate([bfloat16[1,8,256], bfloat16[1,8,768]], axis=-1)
WHY_THE_INTEGER_EXCEEDS_SUPPORTED_RANGE: XLA's HLO lexer attempts to parse the internally emitted 70-bit decimal literal 936300721122945432094 using an integer representation. The value exceeds both signed and unsigned 64-bit ranges. This is an XLA compiler diagnostic specific to the bfloat16 CUDA concatenate compilation path; the equivalent float32 concatenate does not emit it.
WHETHER_IT_REACHES_JAX_XLA_COMPUTATION: It reaches XLA compilation as an internal compiler/lexer diagnostic, but it is not an input value or PRNG seed and is not present in the computed tensor. Compilation completes and results are reproducible.
FIX_IF_REQUIRED: No repository fix is required. Changing bfloat16/JAX/XLA solely to silence it would alter an approved core dependency or compute dtype. Keep the warning visible and monitor it. Evaluation PRNG keys are explicitly uint32[2].
minimal_reproducer_result: warning reproduced outside CoRe-WM, checkpoint loading, hashing, SeedSequence, replay, and model code
